purpose: Isolate FreeCAD's native DXF MINSERT array handling from DWG writing and conversion, using an existing tracked AC1015 control.

consumer.importer: C++ DXF importer, Draft DxfImportMode 2, legacy importer disabled

procedure.validation: CMake configure registered the diagnostic; CTest passed 1/1 in 0.53 seconds outside the sandbox. A first sandboxed FreeCADCmd launch stopped before macro execution because Qt could not detect ARM NEON; that attempt is not consumer evidence.
procedure.result: Both direct importDXF.open and importDXF.insert create one App::Link containing only the first MINSERT cell. The control's DXF array values remain present; this isolates a FreeCAD consumer behavior gap.

limits: This checks FreeCAD 1.1.4 on macOS ARM64 only and uses an existing tracked DXF directly; it does not exercise libdxfrw conversion in this receipt.
The run does not authorize changing standard MINSERT output or expanding arrays inside libdxfrw; compliant DXF consumers may already apply array fields.
Hosted Linux/Windows FreeCAD behavior and other MINSERT profiles remain unqualified.
supportClaimEffect: none; records a native FreeCAD MINSERT array-expansion gap for direct DXF open and insert only
